main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads T test cases each containing N two-dimensional integer points, stores absolute dx/dy descriptors for every point pair whose dx*dy product is negative, sorts the descriptors to group equal slopes, and prints Case #... as one plus the number of distinct slope groups found." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read integer cases from standard input using scanf("%d", &cases) without checking the return value. RESULT cases]
            [COMMAND Start the outer test-case loop: for (int cas = 1; cas <= cases; cas++). RESULT cas]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, read integer N from standard input using scanf("%d", &N) without checking the return value. RESULT N]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, for each int i from 1 to N inclusive, read two integers into input[i][0] and input[i][1] using scanf("%d %d", &input[i][0], &input[i][1]) without checking the return value. RESULT input]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, initialize int pair = 0. RESULT pair]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, for each int i from 1 to N inclusive and for each int j from i + 1 to N inclusive, compute long long int tmp = input[i][0] - input[j][0]; then perform tmp *= input[i][1] - input[j][1]; if tmp < 0, set array[pair].x = abs(input[i][0] - input[j][0]), set array[pair].y = abs(input[i][1] - input[j][1]), and increment pair. RESULT array,pair]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, if pair == 0, take the alternative flow that prints Case #cas: 1 and continues to the next test case; otherwise continue to sorting. RESULT branch_on_pair_zero]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, when pair > 0, sort the first pair elements of array using qsort(array, pair, sizeof(arr), comp). RESULT sorted_array]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, after sorting, initialize int ans = 2. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, for each int i from 1 to pair - 1 inclusive, compute long long int c1 = array[i - 1].x * array[i].y and long long int c2 = array[i - 1].y * array[i].x; if c1 != c2, increment ans. RESULT ans]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop over cas, after counting, print "Case #%d: %d\n" with cas and ans. RESULT printed_output]
            [COMMAND After the outer loop over cas completes, return 0 from main. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: pair == 0]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Print "Case #%d: 1\n" using the current value of cas. RESULT printed_output]
            [COMMAND Continue to the next iteration of the outer test-case loop, skipping the sorting and counting steps for this test case. RESULT next_case]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
